Check data conformity

bdy_check_alldata.Rd

Checks that all data required for the analyses are loaded; see Vignette for more details.

Usage

bdy_check_alldata(
  windfarms_L93,
  colonies_all,
  formatted_mortality,
  countData,
  vital_rates,
  seasons,
  foraging_ranges,
  countryShape
)

Arguments

windfarms_L93

sf object indicating the position of windfarms, for instance bdydata_windfarm_example; must be in EPSG 2154

colonies_all

sf table with information about colonies, as outputed by bdy_summarise_colonies(). Should have at least the following columns:

  • 'colony': character, textual name for the colony

  • 'lat': numeric, latitude of the colony centroid

  • 'lon': numeric, longitude of the colony centroid

  • 'seafront': character, name of the seafront on which the colony is located (for instance 'Atlantic', 'Mediterranean'...)

  • 'colony_code': character, unique identifier for each colony

  • ' geometry" : sf coordinates of the colony centroid

formatted_mortality

data frame giving mortality estimates for the species of interest and the wind farms of interest. Should have at least the following columns:

  • 'species_latin': character, latin name of the species

  • 'windfarm': character, names of the windfarm for which the mortality due to collisions is estimated ('parc' is also accepted as a column name)

  • 'month': numeric, month of the year (1 to 12) for which the mortality is estimated

  • 'iteration': numeric, iteration index of the mortality model.

  • 'coefficient': numeric, estimated mortality coefficient from the mortality model, for a given combination of windfarm, month and iteration

For an example see bdydata_mortality_example

countData

data frame of bird counts (at species level), where each line gives the number of individuals counted for a given colony, species, and year. Should have at least the following columns:

  • 'species_latin': character, latin name of the species

  • 'year': numeric, year during which the observation was made

  • 'colony': character, name of the colony where the observation was made, which should be found also in th column 'colony' of argument 'colonies'

  • 'count': numeric, the count value for this given year, colony, species

  • 'colony_code': character, unique identifier for each colony

vital_rates

table of species vital rates (rows = species), for instance bdydata_vital_rates. Should contain at least the following columns:

  • 'species_latin': character, latin name of the species

  • 'age': numeric, the age corresponding to the given parameters

  • 'class': character, the age class corresponding to a given age for this species ('Juv' for juvenile, 'Imm' for immature, 'Sub' for subadult, 'Adu' for adult)

  • 'survival': numeric between 0 and 1, the survival rate for the given species and age

  • 'fecundity': numeric between 0 and 1, the fecundity rate for the given species and age

  • ' propRepro" : numeric between 0 and 1, the proportion of reproductive individuals for the given species and age

foraging_ranges

table of species foraging ranges, for instance bdydata_foraging_ranges. Should contain at least the following columns:

  • 'species_latin': character, latin name of the species

  • 'terrestrial_habits': boolean, whether this species may fly overland (True) or is strictly marine (False)

  • 'max_km': numeric, the maximum foraging range of this species in kilometers

countryShape

sf object with the shape of countries shoreline, for instance cropped from bdydata_world_map

season

table of species presence status on the coast of interest for each month of the year (rows = species).
Should have a column named 'species_latin" with the latin name of each species, and one column per month (named 'Jan','Feb','Mar', 'Apr', 'May', 'Jun', 'Jul', 'Aug', 'Sep', 'Oct', 'Nov', 'Dec') giving the presence status, with:
'B' = breeding, 'R' = resident, 'T' = transition, 'M' = mixed, 'V' = visiting, 'A' = absent.
For example, see bdydata_seasons, and for more details refer to the Birdynamic report by Chambert et al.

Value

a text message if all data are valid, an error if any problem was detected
